page.overview:
Who is Eighteen Arhats?

The are a group of arhats who were disciples of the Tathagata Buddha himself.

The Tathagata Buddha dispatched the Eighteen Arhats to defeat the Single Horned Rhinoceros King by covering him in grains of cinnabar sand. When this didn’t work, the Arhat Who Mastered a Dragon and the Arhat Who Tamed a Tiger inform Sun Wukong that the Buddha told them to seek out Laozi if they failed.
